=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:425-464 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: SEMBLE_AVAILABLE is never switched to true after a successful install, so the Semble index build always skips.
  WHY: The successful path only exports SEMBLE_BIN, while the later guard still checks SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=false by default, making the feature dead end-to-end.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:134-146, 425-440 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The structured Semble telemetry path was removed, so the success path no longer emits SEMBLE_QUERY and the fallback path no longer preserves the structured fields reviewers/tests expect.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers confirmed the contract tests assert on the old telemetry format, and the new bare print path drops the structured logging contract.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:303-308, 392-395 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_normalize_semble_max_chunks` was removed, so invalid or oversized top-k values now flow straight through to Semble.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the previous clamp is gone, which can produce empty/error queries and breaks the existing chunk-cap expectation in the Semble path.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-128, 223-229 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The issue_meta_matches_issue ownership check was removed and replaced with a non-empty-file check.
  WHY: That makes stale metadata from another issue eligible for reuse, which can inject the wrong labels/body into the diagnose flow; one reviewer treated the regression as a defense-in-depth loss, but all flagged the correctness risk.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:entire file | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The new contract test is not referenced by any CI workflow allowlist, so it will never run automatically.
  WHY: The workflows invoke explicit test files rather than discovery, so this regression guard is effectively inert.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:124-133 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `append_semble_query_section` is defined but never called.
  WHY: All reviewers agreed it is dead code with no runtime effect, only maintenance overhead.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:299-317 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The optional Semble bootstrap scripts are installed into `scripts/` but never appended to `_fetched_scripts`.
  WHY: That leaves them out of generated ignore lists, so consumer repos can see untracked-file noise or accidentally commit them.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:38-42, 57-60 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The unresolved-placeholder guard only catches `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` when it occupies an entire trimmed line.
  WHY: An inline placeholder would pass through literally into the rendered prompt; reviewers agreed current templates avoid this, but the guard is too narrow.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:436, 459 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `SEMBLE_BIN` is written to `$GITHUB_ENV` twice.
  WHY: The second write is redundant and confusing; one reviewer called it harmless, but several flagged the duplicate ownership signal as noise.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-381 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose-flow Semble prefetch block was removed.
  WHY: Reviewers said this drops repo-aware context from the diagnose prompt; one reviewer rejected it as intentional scope reduction, so the disagreement is about whether that loss is acceptable.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:entire file | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The file was modified even though it was outside the issue's files_touched list.
  WHY: Reviewers called this scope expansion because it changes Semble behavior and contracts that were not supposed to be touched in this issue; one reviewer considered it cleanup rather than a bug.
